title.text: Plans, rebuilt around one plan per deck

model.text:
The model

1. Every deck has one plan: a Bracket 4 build, plus the swap bags back to 3 and 2.
2. A plan is in one state: Waiting for your OK, In progress, Done, or Archived.
3. Approving is one button for the whole plan. Skip any change first; answer open questions first.
4. A new version of a plan you're working on also waits for your OK. Until then the old version keeps going.
5. Version, date and source are a plain line under the title, never a chip.

start.text:
Where to start

Plans opens on what needs you: the oldest plan waiting for your OK, one button.
After that everything you approved feeds one page, Get the cards: buy, print, move between decks, put in. Each plan page links there, filtered to that deck.
There is one way to reach a deck's plan: its tile on Plans (and Plan on the deck's own page).

removed.text:
What goes away

The sub-nav Overview, Review, Buy, Trip, Prints, Spares, Settings: becomes Plans and Get the cards (Settings moves to a link).
A deck page's six tabs (Changes, Stock, Now, After prints, Brackets, Lab): one page with the bracket picker on top, Lists and Lab as links.
"Your plan file · tracked", "Plans for this deck" chips, "Track this build", "Where they came from", "N more plans".
Notes as plans: the seven notes are archived once folded in.

data.text:
The data in these boards

Blight Curse: the 27 Oct commander review's Bracket 4 build (38 changes, Mothership prices checked 28 Oct).
Revival Trance: 42 changes, 39 in (from the brief), and the Karmic Guide question. The three left are my reading of plan file v32: check them.
Other in-progress counts are plan file v32's install marks; Yama's own marks may add more.
Riders of Rohan's new version: the 10 changes proposed in your plan file.
New decks' counts are the review's B4 builds; the plans being written now may differ.
[n] means I don't have the number. Art and card pictures are placeholders; the app loads them from Scryfall.

today.text:
Where a plan shows up today (11 ways in)

Decks › Plans tiles; a note's page /decks/research/:id; its deck page /decks/research/:id/:deck; the tracked page /decks/plan/d/:key with 6 tabs; Review; Buy; Trip; Prints (+ swap sheet, MPC); Spares; Swap cards /decks/builds; Suggested changes; the public /r/ page. Plus "Plans for this deck" chips between them.

pairs.text:
Both cards on every change (Bryan, 8 Nov)

Each change shows the card going in, then the card it replaces, small, with an arrow between. Tap either for the full card (Scryfall's normal image in a sheet). The text says "replaces", so the order reads the same in words and pictures.
Phone: the same pair at 34 px wide. A change with no cut named shows a dashed empty slot.

density.text:
Laptop density and structure (Bryan, 8 Nov)

Laptop controls are 36 px, the primary 40 px, row actions 32 px; phones keep 44 px. Secondary buttons have 10 px corners; pills stay for the primary and segmented controls.
At most three secondaries beside the primary; the rest in a More menu that floats, never expands inline.
Nothing touches: a row of actions sits 16 px below what's above it.
Long pages get a sticky strip of section tabs instead of stacked disclosures (a plan: Changes, Questions, How it plays). The approve panel stays in view while you scroll.
Heroes are about 220 px tall with a 64 px title on a laptop.

deck-title.text: The deck page, with one clear set of actions

deck-changed.text:
What changed and why

1. A compact hero (about 220 px, a 60 px title) with Bracket, Value and Record tiles on the right.
2. One ActionBar: Edit list (primary), Check cards, Share, then More, a floating menu with Delete last. Play and Sample hand moved into More.
3. One List picker for the list and the bracket: the list in the box, the same list at Bracket 3 or 2 with the swap bag, Stock, older snapshots.
4. Section tabs: Cards, Stats, Plan, History, each a real subpage with its content open. No folds for main content.
5. Cards: every list control visible, the type bar, collapsible groups with count and price, and Why this bracket beside the list.
6. Laptop density: 36 px controls, 40 px primary, 32 px row actions, 10 px corners; 16 px under every action row.

deck-gone.text:
What goes away

The pill rows and the inline More expander (and its phone copy); the phone action bar.
The hero's list pills and the separate Play it at switch: one picker.
The column of folds under the cards (market value, Game Changers, Reserve List, Bracket, Results, Deck stats, credits): their content moves to the tabs, open.
The separate Deck stats board: it is the Stats tab now.
The Text layout, the Edit deck textarea, the Prices view and its tabs, the Lists panel and Playgroup variants, the bracket and ownership selects, Delete in the settings footer, confirm() boxes.

deck-data.text:
The data in these boards

Card list: plan file v32's after-prints list for Revival Trance (commander-decks data/planner/yama-plan.json, 5 Nov). Prints there show as proxies (25), the rest real (75).
Game Changers per bracket and swap bags: the same file. Types, mana values, curves, colors, Reserve List and Terra's artist (Marta Nael): the Scryfall card data in data/audit/2026-10-27/scryfall (28 Oct). Combos: the Commander Spellbook results saved on 27 Oct.
History's three lists are examples built from the plan's bought cards and prints; Yama's real versions may differ. Themes are my reading of the card text. Plan progress, prices, value, record, declared bracket and the suggestion: [n].

deck-pairs.text:
Both cards on every swap (Bryan, 8 Nov)

Wherever a card replaces another (the bracket swap bag, Edit the list's changes, History, Check), the card going in shows first, then an arrow, then the card it replaces, with the words "replaces". Tap either picture for the full card.
Phone: the same pair at 40 px wide.

deck-links.text:
Where things live now

Cards tab: the list, its controls, Why this bracket and the declared bracket.
Stats tab: curve, colors, themes, combos, online play.
Plan tab: the plans canvas's "A plan in progress" page under this header, plus Ideas (linked to the plan, never adding cards themselves).
History tab: earlier lists with each change as two cards, Put this list back, games.
ActionBar: Edit list, Check cards (scan, check the box, compare with collection), Share; More holds Play, Sample hand, export, Mythic, collection, history, settings, Ask Claude, Delete.

deck-scrycheck.text:
Borrowed from ScryCheck (Bryan, 8 Nov)

Header stat tiles; Why this bracket with named markers; every list control visible; the type bar that jumps to groups; group headers with count and price; the curve with a comparison line; symbols against sources; themes with their core cards; combos as card pictures; gaps with Add options, here Ideas linked to the plan.
Not borrowed: all-caps labels, middle-dot meta lines, the radar chart, per-card point breakdowns as the default view, the sign-in nag.
